public_payload.normalized_proposition: Anthropic's costs will grow dramatically every year.

statement.excerpt: This leaves Anthropic in a worrying position where the only guarantees it has are that its costs will expand dramatically, every single year without fail.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading concerns substantial annual growth in company-wide operating costs, including compute, rather than only one expense category.
Compare complete future financial years on a consistent basis. The first complete calendar year after publication is 2027.
Dramatically means substantial growth, but the speaker provides no percentage threshold. A marginal increase would remain ambiguous.
The universal wording allows a flat or declining future year to contradict the claim; a finite sequence of increases cannot prove it indefinitely.
criteria.support_condition: Every relevant future annual comparison shows substantial growth in comparable total operating costs. A finite series can support the trend but cannot conclusively establish the unrestricted every-year claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A complete future year has flat or declining comparable total operating costs relative to the preceding year.
